findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "One eye, many formats." → 3 lines (4 words, 88px); "Have something good in mind?" → 4 lines (5 words, 128px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 9 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Film / stills / movement" above "Stories in motion."; "19 years old · India" above "NS"; "A point of view" above "Make the everyday feel cinematic."; "Moving image" above "Training, in rhythm"; "On set" above "Between the frames"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "Nehul Sinha", "Film · photography · movement", "Explore", "Work"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 2 tiny uppercase letter-spaced label(s): "Nehul Sinha", "Film · photography · movement"
findings.fix: Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 11 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): article.work-entry.is-visible 709px | article.work-entry.is-visible 709px | article.work-entry.is-visible 709px | article.is-visible 384px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Cream + terracotta palette (text #e9e4da, section #e9762b, button #e9762b, text #e9762b).
findings.fix: Re-draw the palette from the library. This pairing reads as an assistant brand, not yours.

findings.message: Typeface(s) declared but not loaded, so a fallback is rendering: Inter Tight, JetBrains Mono
findings.fix: Fix the font URL / family name, or the screenshots you are judging are not the design.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.
